datasets.name: TLFS23 (Tamil Language Finger Spelling), folders 1-13
datasets.version_or_subset: Mendeley Data 39kzs5pxmk version 2; folders 1-13 (the 12 vowels and the aytham), 1,000 JPEGs each at 640x480; the conditional runs sample 300 per class with seed 1
datasets.license_or_permission: CC BY 4.0 (Mendeley Data record); permits cloud processing and redistribution with attribution. The data is not redistributed by this study.

files.role: SHA-256 of all 13,000 files, each verified against Mendeley's published hash at download

datasets.known_mismatch: The paper's Figure 2 shows 3,903 images in 13 classes, with folder names like '1 அ(a)' and '10 ஒ(o)'; the public release has 1,000 images per class in folders named '1'..'13'. The authors' subset, its folder renaming and its provenance are unknown. The paper also describes in-house collection ('high-resolution camera', 224x224 RGB, indoor and outdoor) while the abstract calls the data TLFS23; TLFS23 images are 640x480. Sec. IV.C lists 12 vowel classes labelled 0-11, but Figure 2 and all confusion matrices have 13 classes. 64 of the 13,000 stored files are exact duplicates of another file.

conditional_results.note: Conditional evidence only, from invented choices; not target results. Single seed (1), 780 test images (60 per class), weighted precision/recall/F1. Final training accuracy shows that this reconstruction underfits: it is far from the paper at every learning rate, and with lr 0.01 and 0.001 it collapses to predicting one class.
conditional_results.preprocessing_check: Locally applying train.py's preprocessing to six sample images kept the hands clearly visible (skin-mask coverage 10-23% of the frame), so the underfitting is not caused by blank inputs.

preflights.note: One preflight of all four learning rates (20 images per class: 208 train, 52 test; 2 epochs) on 2026-10-05 at 10:23 UTC, app ap-qnO7UOMHR9oL4nHRg5vXlS. It loaded and preprocessed real data, trained, saved and reloaded the model, and emitted all metrics; exit 0. No stop policy was declared for it, so it is documented here rather than as a run entry. Outputs remain under preflight-lr-*/ in the results Volume.

Paper Sec. IV.E-F (pp. 5-6): three 3x3 convolutional layers, a Bi-LSTM and dense layers of 256, 128 and 64 units with dropout; filter counts, pooling, LSTM units, the image-to-sequence mapping and the dropout rate are not given.
Paper: no epochs, batch size, augmentation parameters, HSV thresholds, gamma value, Gaussian kernel, seed or checkpoint rule anywhere in the text.
No code was found (sources[] and dead_ends[]).
gates.required_action: Obtain the authors' code, data subset and split (author contact is a human decision), or accept that the runs stay conditional.

gates.reason: The Section IV paragraph's 85.77 / 65.54 / 85.77 / 75.79 cannot be tied to any configuration in the paper.
evidence: Paper Sec. IV iv (p. 7): '569 out of 663 were right, resulting in an accuracy of 85.77%', precision 65.54%, F1 75.79%; no learning rate, figure or configuration is attached, and 569/663 is 85.82%, not 85.77%.
Sec. IV.G reports four learning rates (Figures 4-7), none of which matches these numbers, and the test-set size implied by Figure 6 (about 60 per class, 780 total) differs from 663.

alternatives.description: The configuration the authors used for these numbers.
Treat the paragraph as unattributable and drop these four targets.
alternatives.paper_evidence: 569/663 does not equal 85.77%, and no figure matches.

dead_ends.detail: No code link in the paper. Web searches on 2026-10-05 for the exact title with the authors' names and 'github OR code', and for 'Tamil sign language Uyir Ezhuthukal BiLSTM hand skin mask gamma correction TLFS23', returned the IEEE record, the authors' institutional repository and the TLFS23 data paper only. The queue lists code_repos N/A.
IEEE Xplore is paywalled (not open access per Unpaywall and IEEE metadata); the institutional repository serves a 3-page excerpt. The user supplied the full PDF.
Failed on a transient TLS error from Mendeley (curl exit 35) before anything was uploaded; data.sh was changed to retry all errors with fewer parallel requests and then completed.

author_contact.decision: On 2026-10-05 the user decided to close the attempt without contacting the authors: most important hyperparameters are missing and the reported results are internally inconsistent, so a reply would be unlikely to make any target reproducible.
author_contact.detail: No author was contacted. The two open gates remain unresolved by that decision.

ethics.investigation: The queue record gives no reason for the flag. The paper describes data collected from multiple participants without reporting consent. This attempt used only the public TLFS23 release (CC BY 4.0, described in a peer-reviewed data paper), processed it privately, involved no new participants and published nothing.

closure.state: Closed as insufficient_information; no further runs or contact planned.
